Can you compare your two most popular options and tell me which is better for me?
Two of our most popular games are Watergate and Ark Nova.
Watergate ($34.95 USD) is a fast-paced, 2-player political deduction game that takes about 30–60 minutes. It's great if you want a tense, head-to-head match on a modest budget.
Ark Nova ($79.99 USD) is a deep, strategic game where you plan and design a modern zoo for 1–4 players, with games lasting around 90–150 minutes. It's ideal if you prefer immersive, heavy strategy for longer gaming sessions.
If you want quick setup, easy-to-learn rules, and high value for two players, Watergate is your best pick. If you want a deep strategic hobby game you can dive into for hours, go with Ark Nova.
